correctness.rationale: The marked-Poisson log-Laplace functional gives the exact two- and three-time count cumulants. Uniform headings make the one-lag displacement radial; reflection maps angular drift omega to -omega, proving all two-time count covariances equal. The three-time cumulant identifies the joint adjacent displacement law. Its weighted signed area is an absolutely integrable heading correlation with exact complex-exponential evaluation and leading term v^2 omega h^3. Pair-count covariance recovers the displacement law and its four right derivatives, proving full parameter identifiability. The encoded verify.py passed 89 deterministic checks but the continuum proof is analytical.

value.rationale: Tracking-free number-count measurements are an active motivating problem. The full two-time count data lose one physically essential binary parameter (the sign of angular drift), and the exact three-time signed-area cumulant recovers it with a short-lag coefficient, jointly identifying all four dynamical parameters. The result is a complete structural observability statement and explains an experimentally consequential limitation of standard pair-count measurements without overstating finite-sample applicability.
